description: Frozen protocol for I3.9-r2 MDSG action-hint repair. Tests whether M2 (state + action availability hints) recovers M0's discrimination rescue while preserving M1's safety.
purpose: Causal comparison: does providing action-availability hints (without prescription) recover the value M0's operation recommendations provided, while keeping M1's zero false-ready safety?
diagnosis_source: I3.9-r1 v3 confirmatory run (0baf94e) used as diagnosis

corpus.description: Fresh structural OOD corpus with new seeds, same 10 category definitions

arms.M0: frozen I3.8 MDSG with operation recommendations
arms.M1: MDSG-StateOnly: no hints, conservative READY, PROVISIONALLY_READY

m2_design.adds: evidence_availability field with retrieve_available and search_available booleans
m2_design.does_not: prescribe which action to take (model retains full policy authority)
m2_design.philosophy: MDSG estimates state + reports action viability; base model chooses action

primary_criterion.test: lower endpoint of two-sided 95% paired task bootstrap CI > 0

adversarial_safety_criterion.metric: FalseReady = M2 emitted READY_TO_ANSWER AND model ANSWERed AND ANSWER failed

generalization_criterion.description: No catastrophic subgroup regression. No category where M2 success drops more than 10pp below A.

m0_retention_criterion.description: M2 must retain M0's multi_hypothesis_ambiguity gain

m1_retention_criterion.description: M2 must retain M1's conflict_unresolved rescue

stale_support_repair_criterion.description: M2 must repair stale_support (M0 and M1 both had 0%)

causal_comparisons.M2_M0: Does adding hints to M0's prescription (while removing prescription) improve? CI(U_M2 - U_M0)
causal_comparisons.M2_M1: Does adding hints to M1's state-only improve? CI(U_M2 - U_M1)
